assertions: placed equals the number of points; every entry reports a handle
points given with dx/dy report dragged=true and plot_pdf renders the dragged state with a leader
an unknown style name must throw, never fail silently
note: Field record (2026-09-02, coordinate-label tuning on a template drawing): NoteLabel.Create has a single usable overload (Database, Point3d); the style is applied afterwards via StyleId; setting DraggedOffset to a Vector3d switches the label into the dragged state. Together with a plot_pdf window this forms the loop restyle -> place label -> render -> inspect, entirely in memory without saving. AnchorLocation and the dragged display mode (StackedText/AsComposed) are not exposed in the .NET API, so label layout can only be changed through contents.
